exposure: Labor induction with PROPESS (controlled-release dinoprostone vaginal delivery system)
cohort: 117 pregnant women requiring labor induction after >37 weeks' gestation at Mie University Hospital between January 2018 and September 2020
finding: The proportion of pregnant women, especially primiparas, who delivered vaginally was significantly higher in the PROPESS group compared to the metreurynter group.
mod_finding: PROPESS for cervical ripening may reduce the risk of undergoing cesarean section in pregnant women requiring labor induction, especially primiparas.
